The backup contains every document, original file, page order and saved edit. Choose a location outside the private app storage so the file remains available after uninstalling.\n\nThe file is not encrypted and may contain personal information. There is no automatic cloud upload.

Choose a ZIP backup created by DocScan. After validation, documents will be added as new copies with their originals and edits. Existing documents are preserved. Restoring the same backup again creates additional copies.
Creating and saving the backup… Keep the app open.
Checking the backup and preparing documents…
Backup did not complete. Check free space and the destination. The backup limit is 2 GB of original data.
Unable to complete restore. Check that this is a valid DocScan backup from a supported version and that the device has enough free space.
Original photo detail after cropping and straightening, without automatic downsizing. Maximum JPEG quality. The unedited original is stored separately. Edited PDF images are rendered at 300 DPI.
Up to 3,200 pixels on the longest edge, for a smaller file.
Up to 1,600 pixels on the longest edge, for storage savings and quick sharing.
The full original is preserved. Device resources are insufficient to process this size. Choose High or Compact export quality, or save the original page files without processing.
Save full original files without cropping, filters or quality changes, including existing photo metadata. Choose a destination folder. Document edits remain in the app and the full backup.
